summary: Verified all 4 new universe features (pet profile edit, special dates, public share album, voice preview) end-to-end. 13/13 backend pytest cases pass; frontend flows for /perfil edit+save, /universo special-dates with days-until, /album memory share toggle, /u/:slug public album (shows Rocco + 1 shared memory, 404 on unknown slug), and /hablar step-3 voice-sample playback all work with correct data-testids.

Task note mentioned public slug 'cuentapatas-demo' but that's the preview subdomain; real pet share_slug is 'cb6f60b6c6' and is what the frontend uses in copyLink (window.location.origin/u/{share_slug}).
Public /u/{slug} correctly omits ai_reflection and hides happened_on when date_unknown=true.
